title: Roundup selection by declared Story types plus editor cuts
description:
**Goal.** A roundup never contains junk. Today `items_in_window` in `src/papyrus_content/newsletter/roundup.py` takes every published non-issue Item in the window, so wiki pages and other non-story items count. Selection must be by declared Story types plus editor cuts.

**Design.** A list declares the Story types it carries (`types: ["article", ...]`; no default of "everything"). Candidates are published Stories of those types in the window since the last sent issue. The order inside each section is the standardized quality ranking (separate story: rating, then Cyclotron confidence, in time buckets), reused as a module, not re-implemented. The draft shows an editor what was left out and why; editors cut or restore items before approval; cuts are kept on the draft record and survive re-assembly. The draft is empty-safe: with nothing eligible, no issue is made.

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Roundup selection
  Scenario: Declared types only
    Given a roundup list that declares the article type
    When the draft is assembled
    Then only published articles in the window are included

  Scenario: Wiki pages
    Given a published wiki page in the window
    Then it is not in the draft

  Scenario: Retired stories
    Given a Story published in the window and retired before assembly
    Then it is not in the draft

  Scenario: Held drafts
    Given a Story whose newest version is an unpublished draft
    Then the draft is not used and only the published version can appear

  Scenario: Editor cuts
    Given an editor cut an item from the draft
    When the draft is assembled again
    Then the item stays cut

  Scenario: Quality order
    Given rated and unrated Stories in one section
    Then they appear in the shared quality order

  Scenario: Nothing eligible
    When no Story qualifies
    Then no draft is created and admins are told

  Scenario: Candidate view
    When an editor opens the draft
    Then they see what was included, what was excluded and why
```

**Depends on:** standardized ranking story; issue-kind story (for the draft record).
**Related:** features_backend/newsletter-roundup.feature (update, do not duplicate).

**Open questions for Ryan:** (1) Should posts ever be in a roundup, or articles only? (2) Cap on items per issue: let the quality order and editor cuts decide, with no fixed number?
